Class Course

java.lang.Object
com.uni.models.Course
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Course>
public class Course extends Object implements Serializable, Comparable<Course>
A university course. Multiple lecture and practice instructors are supported per spec. Comparable by course code (used for alphabetic listings).
